title: Compile Falsification Criteria into Executable Property Tests and Counterexample Searches
target_platform: Local Python hypothesis/property testing harness; evaluating-agent-work; deterministic execution (ceiling 500k tokens, 6 CPU-hours)
hypothesis: For bounded Python components, an agent that translates preregistered claims into property tests and counterexample searches will: (a) detect >= 80% of held-out, non-equivalent semantic mutants; (b) improve detection by >= 20 percentage points over equal-budget example-test generation; (c) produce <= 5% false alarms against verified reference implementations; and (d) finish within 10 minutes per component, excluding initial environment setup.
falsification_criteria: Any threshold missed falsifies the hypothesis. Tests that merely reproduce the implementation behavior without an independent specification do not count. A timeout is not proof of correctness.
experiment: Use 20 small components spanning lease decisions, path normalization, event replay, accounting, and schema transitions. Hold out mutation operators as well as examples. Compare existing tests, example-test generation, and claim-driven property generation against an independent reference implementation or enumerated state model. Curate equivalent mutants before scoring.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Escalate to bounded standard review solely for resolving specification or oracle ambiguities.

related_missions.MISSION-036: CONSUMES: translates formal claim contracts and thresholds into executable property invariants.
related_missions.MISSION-015: SUPPLIES DATA TO: equips self-improvement loops with automated counterexample discovery.
related_missions.MISSION-038: VALIDATES: generates adversarial state-machine schedules for flight board recovery testing.

resources: isolated subprocesses and component fixture repositories; max 500k tokens, 6 CPU-hours
